target.title: fix(agents): avoid false unscheduled note after shell cron add
target.body:
Closes #52972

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who schedule reminders through a shell-driven `openclaw cron add ...` command could still receive the false note saying no reminder was scheduled in the turn.

## Why This Change Was Made

The reminder guard already trusts successful structured `cron` tool adds. This extends the same producer-side counter to successful `exec` and `bash` commands that run `openclaw cron add` and return a cron add response shaped like the CLI output.

The repair also handles the CLI warning path where `openclaw cron add --message ...` emits the missing-agent warning on stderr while still printing the successful JSON receipt on stdout. Exec aggregates stdout and stderr, so the parser now scans the aggregate for a valid cron-add JSON receipt instead of requiring the whole aggregate to be pure JSON. Failed commands and unrelated cron commands are ignored.

## User Impact

Users no longer get a contradictory unscheduled-reminder note after a shell cron add succeeds, including the default-agent warning case. Failed or unrelated shell commands still leave the guard active.

## Evidence

Redacted behavior proof, run from the PR checkout after rebasing on current `main`:

```text
command=openclaw cron add --at +1h --message <redacted> --name reminder
aggregateContainsWarning=true
aggregateContainsJsonReceipt=true
successfulCronAdds=1
hasReminderCommitment=true
falseNotePresent=false
deliveredReply=I'll remind you in an hour.
```

The proof used the production tool lifecycle handlers with a mixed warning-plus-JSON exec aggregate, then applied the production reminder-guard decision to the delivered reply payload.

Focused tests and checks:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  84 passed (84)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner.misc.runreplyagent.test.ts -t "reminder commitment guard"
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  8 passed | 50 skipped (58)

pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

pnpm exec oxlint src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts

pnpm changed:lanes --json
lanes: core, coreTests

git diff --check
```

`pnpm check:changed` failed locally before repository checks because the local Crabbox/Testbox binary failed its basic sanity check. The delegated child command passed after rebase:

```text
env OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 CI=1 PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false corepack pnpm check:changed
[check:changed] lanes=core, coreTests
Import cycle check: 0 runtime value cycle(s).
```
